name: Dead Souls I
english_description: An early, distinct generation of the Dead Souls object library -- per lpmuds.net's own description, this snapshot ('Dead Souls V' per several in-file headers, 1996-98 vintage) is closer to Nightmare IV than to the later 3.8.6-era Dead Souls this collection already hosts as ds386/deadsouls_fluffos. A structural diff confirms it: only 2 domains (default, Ylsrim) vs. the other two copies' 8, no estates/powers/std/open directories, and a byte-level-different, roughly 1/3-the-size master.lpc. Ships a genuine first-boot admin-installation wizard, full login/registration with race selection, a small starting domain plus one example domain (Ylsrim), and preloads a real Intermud-3 client that makes an outbound network connection at boot. Porting it surfaced a batch of missing/mistyped LIB_* master-list macros (LIB_UNDEAD gated behind a garbled #ifdef, LIB_GERM/LIB_VIRT_LAND/LIB_FTP_CLIENT missing outright) that broke compiling this codebase's entire living-creature class hierarchy and several other subsystems, the old-MudOS 'TYPE array NAME' declaration dialect (370+ sites), the .c-to-.lpc rename's fixed-width filename-slice arithmetic (16 sites, including the command-dispatch table itself), this driver's OLD_ED build vs. the archive's new-style ed_start()/ed_cmd() API, and a handful of genuine pre-existing archive bugs (two truncated/corrupted files, a missing lib/capture.lpc component, an abandoned 'declare war' feature, wrong-name typos). 576/585 files pass a full compile sweep; the 9 that don't are all non-preloaded, pre-existing content gaps or archive corruption predating this port.
